title: Resolve Netanya and Ashkelon historical project file identifiers

data.target: Historical Netanya hotel and Ashkelon golf-resort municipal/land file identifiers
data.research_question: What exact parcel, block-lot, application, tender, planning-file and land-authority identifiers correspond to the reported Trump-linked Netanya hotel and Ashkelon golf-resort proposals?
objectives: Recover exact property and application identifiers.
Use those identifiers to retrieve municipal planning, tender and correspondence files.
Resolve whether Israel Land Authority or district-planning files are required.
in_scope: Netanya Municipality engineering and tenders records
Ashkelon Municipality building files and FOI records
out_of_scope: Unsupported inference from current office locations
selection_reason: Current official retrieval surfaces are identified, but the historical project file identifiers remain unresolved.

workflow.next_action: Resolve parcel/block-lot and application identifiers, then recover primary municipal/land files.
